identity.name: Prospex 1965 Heritage Diver 39mm Hi-Beat
identity.one_liner: The 39mm modern Prospex diver with the 36,000 vph hi-beat movement, 200m water resistance, and a 70-hour power reserve at $1,900.

provenance_events.description: Seiko splits the 1965 62MAS family into 39mm (SPB313) and 40.5mm (SPB453) versions with the 6L37 hi-beat movement.

narrative.story: The Prospex 1965 Heritage SPB313 is the most-cited modern Seiko diver: 39mm steel, 200m, ceramic bezel, sapphire crystal, hi-beat 36,000 vph, 70 hours of power reserve.
narrative.collector_notes: The dial is matte black with applied indices; hands are polished. Lume is Seiko's proprietary Lumibrite.
